<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

List all storage resources.

Aliases: `.storages`

## Synopsis

```text
.storage [enabled | disabled]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Not a command of its own but an abbreviation of .storages: like Bareos, the Director accepts any unique prefix of a command name and runs the first matching command. Output, arguments, API modes and permissions are those of .storages. It reads only the configuration; enabled or disabled filter by state.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only enabled resources. |
| `disabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only disabled resources. |

## Examples

List the storage resources:

```text
.storage
```

List only enabled storages:

```text
.storage enabled
```
